verdict.rationale: Mastercard's official Agent Toolkit MCP server lets developers use AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Windsurf to ask natural-language questions about Mastercard services and generate working code. An example prompt is "I need to integrate Open Finance to verify account ownership and check balances." This is natural-language help with documentation and integration, not natural-language operation of the Open Finance APIs themselves. missing for 10: evidence that natural-language commands can execute Open Finance operations (e.g., fetch balances or transactions, create customers), product-specific agent tooling beyond docs/code generation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
